What the evidence shows

A screening system that combines site spectra, land-surface and atmosphere products. Every view retains its spatial scale and missing-data status.

01 · Hyperspectral

Classify industrial context

Tanager L2A reflectance from 48 US sites feeds 57 spectral bins and three indices. The industrial-versus-school pilot achieved 11 correct predictions out of 12 held-out sites across three cities.

02 · Atmosphere

Examine pollutant context

Sentinel-5P atmospheric columns, Sentinel-2 aerosol optical thickness, CAMS modeled air, and ERA5 wind provide complementary regional views with different resolution and meaning.

03 · Plumes

Review source-linked examples

Published Tanager and EMIT CH₄/CO₂ plumes include scene dates and instantaneous rates. The proposed Arizona, Algeria, and Jeddah case-specific downloads are still pending.

Satellite signals can prompt an investigation. A nearby column pixel, thermal contrast, or regional model value alone cannot prove that a particular facility emitted a pollutant.

Plumes & methane

Real published plume examples show what source-resolved detection can look like. They are separate from EcoOrbit's three proposed methane investigation sites.

Published instantaneous rates

Values are kg of the named gas per hour, as reported by the source. These are individual snapshots, not an annual inventory.

Proposed case investigations

Imported case plume candidates

Case-specific records are not included. The suggested 2024 Jeddah dates and 2024–2025 Arizona window are search windows, not confirmed plume detections.

US regional methane context

Sentinel-5P XCH₄ is a regional column in ppb; it does not resolve a source plume.

Air & wind

Choose a city and atmospheric product. Sentinel-5P NO₂/SO₂ columns and Sentinel-2 aerosol optical thickness are observations; CAMS concentrations are modeled regional context.

Observed values

Wind context

Underlying records

NO₂ and SO₂ satellite pixels span kilometres; values are vertical columns in mol/m², not ground concentrations or facility emission rates. AOT represents optical aerosol load without identifying a chemical species. Wind direction is the direction from which the wind blows.

Sites, spectra & heat

The land-use screen is an additional feature of the pollutant-focused PoC. Test predictions span Detroit, Jacksonville and Rochester; the green patches illustrate spectral vegetation contrast.

Registry points with usable source Tanager pixels. Marker size reflects model screening score; select a marker for details.

Held-out classifier

11 / 12 correct AUC 0.944

Site-level 36/12 split stratified across three cities and both classes. 24 industrial points and 24 school controls in the measured set.

The 91.7% result describes the small industrial-versus-school test, not general factory detection. Green space and commercial sites are not labeled test controls in this evaluation.

Landsat surface temperature

Surface excess is site temperature minus local reference, not exhaust stack heat.

Vegetation reference

NDVI 0.770 vs 0.305

Vegetation-like cluster median versus eight Jacksonville industrial-neighborhood medians (+0.465). Twelve sampled green patches locate the reference class; they are not independent labeled park samples.

Hyperspectral classification scene

Provider-corrected Tanager L2A surface reflectance; the scene map is unsupervised material clustering, distinct from the site-level supervised test.

Sentinel-2 vegetation and built-surface change

NDVI and NDBI changes can reflect season, vegetation, surface mix and image quality; they do not establish a facility's environmental impact.

ESG evidence & methods

An evidence register aligned with GRI 305 and GHG Protocol concepts. It reports measured context and explicitly marks what cannot be calculated without facility records.

Reporting status

Scope 1 & 2 inventory pending

No annual facility CO₂e total is available. Fuel/process activity, electricity, documented emission factors, reporting period, and boundaries are required. A plume's instantaneous kg/h rate cannot be annualized without duration evidence.

Satellite NO₂/SO₂ columns, heat and AOT support screening and follow-up. They cannot fill GRI 305 emissions quantities or regulatory compliance fields on their own.

Evidence ladder

Site identity

EPA FRS registry plus pixel-valid imagery; verify parcel and operations.

Environmental context

Observe spectral, thermal, and atmospheric signals with QA.

Source investigation

Inspect plume origin, wind, competing sources, and independent records.

Inventory

Calculate with audited fuel, process and electricity activity and factors.
